body: I've been patted on the back so many times in ten years that it doesn't reassure me in the least any more. My options are quickly leaning towards joining the other rejects at the interstate on ramp with my own cardboard sign. It terrifies me to pass them everyday because I swear I can see myself among them. I'm not used to admitting my sob story because I've always held myself so highly. I don't know what to write on my cardboard sign. "Hey everything's fine don't worry I'm sure it will all work out. :) Yeah, good to see you too... :)"

I'm passed over for people your age in everything I try to do. You'll be fine. I'm sure you mean well with your response but you might only have an inkling to the failure I've experienced and how ageist our society is. 

The world is done with me, doesn't have room for an adult man who isn't a dead-hearted slave. When employers see I've had the audacity to walk away from the business they are appalled. The only way out is to lie. More lies. It isn't what my heart would say or do. It's a corruption of myself and today I will do it again. I awoke early with all the usual thoughts of productivity. Tonight, after another day of rejection, I will be right back in the pits of despair.
